name: Student Advisory Board
subtitle: Student Advises needed?
description:
This certificate recognizes my participation in the Student Advisory Board, which can be considered the student management committee of the school. As part of this group, students were involved in supporting various school activities, coordinating tasks, and occasionally stepping out of regular classes to help with different responsibilities and arrangements around the school.

Although it sometimes meant leaving classes for unexpected tasks, the experience was both fun and insightful. It allowed me to understand how school activities are managed behind the scenes and gave me early exposure to leadership and responsibility. Being part of the Student Advisory Board also played an important role in my journey toward later becoming the President of the Tech Team (TechXperts).

name: E-Magazine Dev
subtitle: Canva in 2025?
description:
This certificate recognizes my participation in the development of the school’s e-Magazine during the 2024–25 session at Dr. B. R. Ambedkar School of Specialised Excellence (ASOSE/RPVV), Dwarka. Contributing to the e-Magazine allowed me to be part of the team responsible for creating and presenting the school’s digital publication.

Working on the e-Magazine helped me gain experience in digital content creation, design coordination, and collaborative work. It was an opportunity to apply my interest in technology and media to a real school project, while also contributing to something that represents the creativity and achievements of the entire school community.

name: TechXperts 2025
subtitle: Tech Team Why?
description:
This certificate recognizes my role in the Tech Team for the 2025 session, where my responsibilities were more focused on supporting the school’s events, parties, and functions. My work mainly involved handling the technical and media aspects during these occasions, ensuring that important moments were properly captured and shared across the school’s digital platforms.

Being part of the team during this session allowed me to continue contributing to the school’s digital presence while gaining more experience in event coordination, media management, and teamwork. Working alongside the team, including Yashpal as Vice President, helped strengthen our collaboration and made the experience both productive and enjoyable. I am also grateful to Hitesh Narayan Sir for continuing to trust and support us in these responsibilities.

name: TechXperts
subtitle: Tech Team what?
description:
This certificate recognizes my role as the President of the Tech Team for the 2024–25 session. It was the first time I was given the responsibility of managing the school’s public digital presence through social media, websites, and other technical platforms. During my leadership, I helped launch the school’s official Instagram account, grew the YouTube channel from around 500 subscribers to about 1.4K, and played a key role in establishing the public official school website, which was a significant step for the school’s online presence. The person with me in the images is Yashpal, who served as the Vice President of the tech team.

This experience helped me gain practical knowledge in many areas, including software, programming tools, and Linux, while also developing leadership and problem-solving skills. It was also during this time that I began focusing on discipline and consistency, something that still continues in my work today. I would also like to sincerely thank Hitesh Narayan Sir for trusting me and giving me this opportunity.

name: International Science Olympiad
subtitle: The Exam Not Prepared For
description:
This certificate represents my participation in the International Science Olympiad (ISO) conducted by the Indian Talent Olympiad during the academic year 2024–25. While studying in Class 9 at Dr. B. R. Ambedkar School of Specialised Excellence, I secured a “B” grade in Round 1 and achieved State Rank 128 in Round 2.

Interestingly, my participation in this exam was quite spontaneous. I only found out that I had been registered for the Olympiad on the day of the exam itself, so I went in without any special preparation. Despite that, I was able to perform well and reach Round 2.

The experience showed me the importance of strong fundamentals and gave me confidence in my understanding of science, even without targeted preparation.

name: Natkhat Utsav
subtitle: Summer "10%" Camp
description:
In June 2025, the government organized a 28-day summer camp focused on creative skills like singing, dancing, and music. Driven by a desperate curiosity to learn everything the world has to offer, I joined in. Although I only attended the initial skills training for the first five days, a unique opportunity pulled me back for the grand finale.

As the camp reached its conclusion with the 'Natkhat Utsav' event, the organizers—Sameer Khan Sir and Rishab Sir—found themselves short on dedicated students. They needed a reliable anchor to lead the show. When they reached out, I figured it was better than being bored at home and said, 'Hell yeah.'

In just two days, I drafted the entire anchoring script using AI with my own personal tweaks. I also took the initiative to design the official invitation card (which you can see in the images). The performance itself was nerve-wracking; it was the first time my mother had ever seen me perform at school, and the pressure was on. Despite the stress, the event was a success. It taught me that even when you don't finish a course, staying available for the 'big stage' can lead to the most valuable lessons of all.

name: TechnoVanza FlipBook
subtitle: The 1st in TechVerse
description:
This certificate represents my first real step into the professional tech world. The challenge was to create a digital flipbook using FlipHTML5—a task that was difficult not just technically, but also because I had to prove myself at home. At the time, I was heavily into gaming, and my parents were concerned I was just wasting time on the screen. However, winning this competition changed everything; it officially marked my entry into the “Techverse” that I’m still exploring today.

I participated as a student of SAM International School, competing in a dual-team format alongside my friend, Sanyam Kumar, which you can see in the photos from the event. For winning the competition, I also received a motivational book as a gift, shown in one of the images, making the achievement even more memorable.

name: PWNSAT 2024
subtitle: Unexpected entry, well-earned victory.
description:
This certificate and medal are from PWNSAT, a scholarship test in which I participated randomly since it was free. I secured a 90% scholarship and received the medal shown in the image, though I did not use the scholarship for several months.

Later, when I realized that I was about to enter Class 10 and would be facing my first board examinations, I felt the need to join a coaching institute. I chose PW, as I was influenced by their technology-driven approach to education. Initially, the course fee was around ₹1 lakh. With the 90% scholarship it was reduced, but since the discount applied only to the tuition fees and an additional ₹5,000 was charged for seat booking, the final amount came to about ₹35,000.

Despite the cost difference, my experience at PW benefited me in many ways—I made new friends, learned new things, and gained valuable exposure that helped me grow both academically and personally.

name: ICMR SHINE
subtitle: One day as a Young Scientist
description:
This certificate represents my participation in the S.H.I.N.E. (Science & Health Innovation for the Nextgen Explorers) program organized by ICMR–NIMR in New Delhi. The event, titled “Spend One Day as a Scientist at ICMR,” gave me a unique opportunity to experience what working in a real scientific research environment feels like.

During the program, I learned about how scientists study diseases such as malaria and how research institutes like ICMR contribute to public health in India. Being inside a real research institute, interacting with experts, and observing scientific discussions made the experience both exciting and inspiring.

The visit helped me understand how science is applied beyond textbooks and how research plays an important role in solving real-world health problems. It was a memorable experience that gave me a glimpse into the life of a scientist and the impact scientific research can have on society.

name: Vishwaroop Olympiad
subtitle: Claiming every chance.
description:
This is a powerful addition to your story. It shows a shift in mindset—moving from winning a specific competition to the "grind" of constantly putting yourself out there. Even without a photo or a winner's trophy, the fact that you qualified for the inter-school stage in 2025 shows real progress from your 9th-grade start.

Here is a polished version that emphasizes your ambition and the "no-excuses" attitude you adopted when joining DBRA-SOSE.

Polished Narrative
"This participation certificate from the Vishwaroop Olympiad represents more than just an entry; it marks a fundamental shift in my mindset. Upon joining DBRA-SOSE, Sector-10, Dwarka in 9th grade, I made a conscious decision to stop letting moments pass me by. I began claiming every opportunity available—a standard move for anyone serious about their career. While I didn't take home a win this time, it was the definitive start of a 'grind' that continues to this day. 


Edit----
In the 2025 Vishwaroop Olympiad, I pushed even further, successfully qualifying through the first stage for inter-school selection. Although I didn't clear the second stage, the experience remains a vital part of my journey. It is what it is—a stepping stone in a much larger story.

name: English Recitation
subtitle: The Beggining of the Collection
description:
Reflecting on my early academic years, this English Recitation certificate from Bishop Boys’ Diocesan School marks an important milestone. Awarded on December 12, 2018, it represents my 2nd place finish in a competition that included students from 1st through 5th grade, despite my doubts about my English skills at the time.

Along with the certificate, I also received a lunch box as a gift—shown in the image—which is still with me even today. Looking back at that day, and the photos of me proudly in my school uniform, reminds me that our potential often exceeds what we believe about ourselves.
